incidents.title: Workspace admins may be unable to manage plugins
incidents.title_zh: Workspace admins may be unable to manage plugins
incidents.message: We are investigating an issue affecting some ChatGPT workspace administrators’ ability to view and manage plugin availability and settings. Some users may also see plugins as unavailable. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.

incidents.title: Some ChatGPT content may be unavailable on Android
incidents.title_zh: Some ChatGPT content may be unavailable on Android
incidents.message: We have identified an issue affecting the ChatGPT Android app where users may see “This content is unavailable in this version of the app” instead of certain content. A fix is rolling out gradually in the latest Android version. Users can use ChatGPT on the web while we work to restore the experience for older app versions.

incidents.title: Delayed Costs data in the Compliance API
incidents.title_zh: Delayed Costs data in the Compliance API
incidents.message: We have implemented a mitigation, and delayed Costs data is now processing through the Compliance API. Some customers may continue to see incomplete Costs data while the backlog catches up. We expect this catch-up process to continue through Sunday, October 11. ChatGPT usage and API Platform requests remain unaffected. We are monitoring recovery.
